title: 1987 Topps #94 Calvin Schiraldi Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1987 Topps baseball card featuring Calvin Schiraldi of the Boston Red Sox. The card is part of the standard size set and is an original vintage piece made of card stock. It is a sports trading card from the Major League (MLB) and is in English. The card number is 94 in the 1987 Topps set.
